arxiv-2102-08191.title: Mass sum rule of hadrons in the QCD instanton vacuum
arxiv-2102-08191.creator: Ismail Zahed
arxiv-2102-08191.description: Abstract We briefly review the key aspect of the QCD instanton vacuum in relation to the quantum breaking of conformal symmetry and the trace anomaly. We use Ji s ′ {}^{\prime}s invariant mass decomposition of the energy momentum tensor together with the trace anomaly, to discuss the mass budget of the nucleon and pion in the QCD instanton vacuum.

arxiv-2209-09422.title: Bit Allocation using Optimization
arxiv-2209-09422.creator: Tongda Xu, Han Gao, Chenjian Gao, Yuanyuan Wang, Dailan He, Jinyong Pi, Jixiang Luo, Ziyu Zhu, Mao Ye, Hongwei Qin, Yan Wang ✉, Jingjing Liu, Ya-Qin Zhang
arxiv-2209-09422.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the problem of bit allocation in Neural Video Compression (NVC). First, we reveal a fundamental relationship between bit allocation in NVC and Semi-Amortized Variational Inference (SAVI). Specifically, we show that SAVI with GoP (Group-of-Picture)-level likelihood is equivalent to pixel-level bit allocation with precise rate & quality dependency model.

arxiv-2211-12977.title: Linear Programming Hierarchies in Coding Theory: Dual Solutions
arxiv-2211-12977.creator: Elyassaf Loyfer, Nati Linial
arxiv-2211-12977.description: Abstract The rate vs. distance problem is a long-standing open problem in coding theory. Recent papers have suggested a new way to tackle this problem by appealing to a new hierarchy of linear programs. If one can find good dual solutions to these LP’s, this would result in improved upper bounds for the rate vs. distance problem of linear codes.

arxiv-2302-04449.title: Read and Reap the Rewards: Learning to Play Atari with the Help of Instruction Manuals
arxiv-2302-04449.creator: Yue Wu, Yewen Fan, Paul Pu Liang, Amos Azaria, Yuanzhi Li, Tom Mitchell
arxiv-2302-04449.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yue Wu, Yewen Fan, Paul Pu Liang, Amos Azaria, Yuanzhi Li, Tom Mitchell. High sample complexity has long been a challenge for RL. On the other hand, humans learn to perform tasks not only from interaction or demonstrations, but also by reading unstructured text documents, e.g., instruction manuals. Instruction manuals and wiki pages are among the most abundant data that could inform agents of valuable features and policies or task-specific environmental dynamics and reward structures.

arxiv-2401-13881.title: Spontaneous stochasticity amplifies even thermal noise to the largest scales of turbulence in a few eddy turnover times
arxiv-2401-13881.creator: Dmytro Bandak, Alexei Mailybaev, Gregory L. Eyink, Nigel Goldenfeld
arxiv-2401-13881.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dmytro Bandak, Alexei Mailybaev, Gregory L. Eyink, Nigel Goldenfeld. How predictable are turbulent flows? Here we use theoretical estimates and shell model simulations to argue that Eulerian spontaneous stochasticity, a manifestation of the non-uniqueness of the solutions to the Euler equation that is conjectured to occur in Navier-Stokes turbulence at high Reynolds numbers, leads to universal statistics at finite times, not just at infinite time as for standard chaos. These universal statistics are predictable, even though individual flow realizations are not.

arxiv-2406-01049.title: Searching For Music Mixing Graphs: A Pruning Approach
arxiv-2406-01049.description: Abstract Music mixing is compositional — experts combine multiple audio processors to achieve a cohesive mix from dry source tracks. We propose a method to reverse engineer this process from the input and output audio. First, we create a mixing console that applies all available processors to every chain.

arxiv-2508-03974.title: Managing Data for Scalable and Interactive Event Sequence Visualization
arxiv-2508-03974.creator: Sayef Azad Sakin, Katherine E. Isaacs
arxiv-2508-03974.description: Abstract Parallel event sequences, such as those collected in program execution traces and automated manufacturing pipelines, are typically visualized as interactive parallel timelines. As the dataset size grows, these charts frequently experience lag during common interactions such as zooming, panning, and filtering. Summarization approaches can improve interaction performance, but at the cost of accuracy in representation.

arxiv-2509-22170.title: Leveraging LLM Agents for Automated Video Game Testing
arxiv-2509-22170.creator: Chengjia Wang, Lanling Tang, Ming Yuan, Jiongchi Yu, Xiaofei Xie, Jiajun Bu
arxiv-2509-22170.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chengjia Wang, Lanling Tang, Ming Yuan, Jiongchi Yu, Xiaofei Xie, Jiajun Bu. Testing MMORPGs (Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games) is a critical yet labor-intensive task in game development due to their complexity and frequent updating nature. Traditional automated game testing approaches struggle to achieve high state coverage and efficiency in these rich, open-ended environments, while existing LLM-based game-playing approaches are limited to shallow reasoning ability in understanding complex game state-action spaces and long-complex tasks.

arxiv-2601-02337.title: Robust Persona-Aware Toxicity Detection with Prompt Optimization and Learned Ensembling
arxiv-2601-02337.creator: Berk Atil, Rebecca J. Passonneau, Ninareh Mehrabi
arxiv-2601-02337.description: Abstract Toxicity detection is inherently subjective, shaped by the diverse perspectives and social priors of different demographic groups. While “pluralistic” modeling as used in economics and the social sciences aims to capture perspective differences across contexts, current Large Language Model (LLM) prompting techniques have different results across different personas and base models.

pmc-11709865.description: BackgroundMaintaining synaptic health is essential for normal neurological function, yet neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer’s disease and Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP) exhibit synaptic loss. pmc-12533546.creator: Siddharth Bansal, Bradley S Peterson, Chaitanya Gupte, Siddhant Sawardekar, Maria J Gonzalez Anaya, Maricar Ordonez, Deepa Bhojwani, Jonathan D Santoro, Ravi Bansal
pmc-12533546.description: We propose a Biophysically Restrained Analog Integrated Neural Network (BRAINN), an analog electrical network that models the dynamics of brain function. pmc-13202267.title: Transcript-independent quantitative analysis of RNA cap structures by LC-MS/MS
pmc-13202267.creator: Ryan Kilburn, Rachel C Gomez, Steven Evans
pmc-13202267.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Incorporation of the 5′ cap into RNA is a critical quality attribute that requires accurate assessment for therapeutic application. pmc-13511187.title: Mitochondrial Cristae as Separate Compartments: Linking Organization and Function
pmc-13511187.creator: Alexander V. Panov, Semen V. Nesterov, Lev S. Yaguzhinsky
pmc-13511187.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Traditional bioenergetic paradigms historically relied on classical equilibrium thermodynamics to calculate mitochondrial kinetics, often overlooking the non-equilibrium processes dictated by complex structural architecture. Recent discoveries fundamentally challenge these outdated views by demonstrating that the inner mitochondrial membrane is strictly segregated into distinct functional domains, where individual cristae operate as autonomous, ultra-confined nanocompartments, where the transport of metabolites and protons is tightly controlled by ultrastructure-assisted electric and entropic effects.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Reports and Briefings.— (1) Not later than 30 days after the end of the second and fourth quarter of each calendar year, the Secretary of Defense shall submit to Congress a report regarding the military readiness.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The laws of Guam in force on August 1, 1950, except as amended by this chapter, are continued in force, subject to modification or repeal by the Congress of the United States or the Legislature of Guam, and all laws.
